title: Senior Mendix Developer
description:
We are seeking an experienced **Senior Mendix Developer** with strong hands-on expertise in low-code application development, enterprise application architecture, integrations, and end-to-end solution delivery. The ideal candidate will be responsible for designing, developing, enhancing, and maintaining scalable, secure, and high-performance applications using the Mendix platform.

The successful candidate will collaborate with business stakeholders, solution architects, product owners, and cross-functional engineering teams to translate complex business requirements into robust technical solutions. This role requires strong proficiency in **Mendix Studio Pro, domain modeling, microflows, nanoflows, application security, API integrations, and application lifecycle management**, along with the ability to provide technical guidance and support high-quality project delivery.

**Key Responsibilities:-**

* **Solution Design & Development:** Design, develop, and maintain scalable enterprise-grade applications using Mendix Studio Pro and low-code development methodologies.
* **Requirements Analysis:** Collaborate with business stakeholders and product owners to understand functional requirements and translate them into technical specifications and solution designs.
* **Mendix Development:** Build and optimize domain models, microflows, nanoflows, pages, reusable components, and application logic in accordance with Mendix development best practices.
* **Enterprise Integrations:** Develop and maintain integrations with REST/SOAP APIs, relational databases, and external enterprise applications.
* **Application Security:** Implement appropriate authentication, authorization, access controls, and data security measures to ensure secure application delivery.
* **Performance Optimization:** Analyze application performance, troubleshoot bottlenecks, and implement improvements to scalability, responsiveness, and reliability.
* **Quality Engineering:** Conduct code reviews, unit and integration testing, defect analysis, debugging, and root-cause investigation.
* **Application Lifecycle Management:** Support version control, deployment management, environment configuration, CI/CD pipelines, and production releases.
* **Production Support:** Monitor application health, resolve production issues, and deliver enhancements and corrective fixes as required.
* **Agile Collaboration:** Participate in sprint planning, backlog refinement, technical discussions, estimation, and delivery reviews.
* **Technical Leadership:** Mentor junior developers, promote coding standards, review technical solutions, and contribute to architectural and implementation decisions.
* **Documentation:** Maintain technical specifications, integration documentation, deployment procedures, and application support guides.

**Mandatory Skills & Experience:-**

* 6–8 years of relevant professional experience, including substantial hands-on experience in Mendix application development.
* Strong practical expertise in **Mendix Studio Pro** and the development of enterprise-grade low-code applications.
* Proven experience across the complete Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC), from requirement analysis and solution design to deployment and production support.
* Strong understanding of Mendix domain modeling, microflows, nanoflows, data entities, associations, and application logic.
* Experience designing and implementing secure, maintainable, and reusable Mendix application components.
* Hands-on experience integrating Mendix applications with REST/SOAP APIs, relational databases, and external systems.
* Knowledge of application security, role-based access control, data protection, and secure development practices.
* Familiarity with Agile/Scrum methodologies, source control, testing practices, and CI/CD processes.
* Strong analytical, troubleshooting, communication, and stakeholder-management skills.
* Ability to work effectively in a collaborative, hybrid delivery environment.

**Preferred / Good-to-Have Skills:-**

* Mendix Advanced or Expert certification.
* Experience with cloud-based deployments, environment management, application monitoring, and performance tuning.
* Familiarity with Java, JavaScript, or other technologies used to extend Mendix capabilities.
* Experience working on enterprise-scale applications, complex integrations, or multi-team delivery programs.
* Exposure to automated testing, DevOps practices, and continuous delivery pipelines.
* Experience providing technical mentorship and contributing to solution architecture decisions.

**Key Success Metrics:-**

* Timely delivery of reliable, scalable, and high-quality Mendix applications.
* Application performance, stability, security, and maintainability.
* Quality of integrations and effectiveness in resolving technical issues.
* Compliance with development standards, testing practices, and release processes.
* Effective collaboration with stakeholders and cross-functional teams.
* Contribution to team productivity, technical capability, and continuous improvement.

Pay: ₹2,800,000.00 - ₹3,200,000.00 per year

* Have you used Studio Pro, Microflows, Nanoflows and APIs?
* How many years of hands-on Mendix experience do you have?

* What is your current and expected CTC (LPA)?
* What is your notice period?

Education:

* Bachelor's (Required)

title: AI Application Developer
description:
AI Application Developer

Fresh Graduates | AI Tools & LLM-Assisted Development

Experience: Fresh graduates / 0–1 year | Employment: Full-time

About the Role

We are looking for fresh graduates who have already used AI tools to build something real—an application, automation, chatbot, dashboard, website, or working prototype. You will use LLMs and AI-assisted development tools to turn business problems into usable software, test ideas quickly, and improve solutions based on feedback. Projects may include workflow automation, AI-powered analytics, and video intelligence; prior domain expertise is not required.

What You Will Do

* Build and iterate on practical AI-enabled applications, internal tools, automations, and proof-of-concepts.

* Use tools such as ChatGPT, Claude Code, OpenAI Codex, Cursor, or similar platforms to write, debug, and improve code.

* Connect LLMs, external APIs, databases, and existing open-source components into working workflows.

* Translate business requirements into simple prototypes, test with real inputs, and refine for reliability and usability.

* Create basic user interfaces, dashboards, and reports; document how the solution works and demonstrate results.

* Explore new AI tools independently and choose the simplest effective approach for each problem.

What We Are Looking For

* A graduate in Computer Science, IT, Engineering, Data Science, or a related field—or equivalent demonstrable project skills.

* Hands-on experience using LLMs or AI coding assistants to build at least one functioning project (academic, personal, freelance, or internship work).

* Basic programming ability (preferably Python or JavaScript) and confidence reading, modifying, and debugging code.

* Ability to work with APIs, follow technical documentation, search GitHub/open-source projects, and learn unfamiliar tools.

* Strong problem-solving, ownership, curiosity, and ability to clearly explain what you built and your own contribution.

Good to Have — Not Mandatory

* Experience with LLM APIs, prompt design, RAG, agents, workflow automation, FastAPI, Streamlit, or cloud deployment.

* Familiarity with computer vision or video intelligence tools such as YOLO, OpenCV, PyTorch, TensorFlow, object detection, tracking, or vision-language models.

* Experience shipping an end-to-end project, integrating a database, or collecting user feedback to improve an app.

How to Apply

Send your resume along with links to 1–3 projects (GitHub, live demo, video walkthrough, or portfolio). For each project, briefly state the problem solved, the AI tools you used, what actually works, and what you personally built. Shortlisted candidates may be asked to demonstrate or extend one of their projects in a practical discussion.

Work Location: Hybrid remote in Kolkata, West Bengal
